headline: Lithium Fund Gains 0.97% as Albemarle and SQM Hold Steady
summary: The lithium fund LIT rose 0.97% to US$61.27 on Monday while Albemarle and SQM barely moved, showing little contagion from Brazil's market crash.
why: Specialty chemical and battery mineral equities are driven by long-term electric vehicle adoption trends and supply-demand fundamentals rather than localized Latin American equity crashes.

entities.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A.

impacts.name: Global X Lithium & Battery Tech ETF
impacts.why: Gained 0.97% to US$61.27 as sector investments decoupled from regional equity crashes.
